title: You Swapped Places with a Billionaire, Part 5
premise: Your new face unlocks the billionaire’s phone, but the fictional bank asks for a childhood pet’s name.

scenes.anchor: Your new face opens his phone.
scenes.description: The phone is already moving into view; its face lock resolves once.
scenes.label: face-hook

scenes.anchor: Your new face opens his phone.
scenes.description: Cut to the adult caller after the short face-unlock insert; no held balance screen.
scenes.label: hook-caller

scenes.anchor: What was your first pet called?
scenes.description: The same phone asks for the first pet’s name; the financial obstacle is explicit.
scenes.label: question-hook

scenes.anchor: What was your first pet called?
scenes.description: Adult viewer calls the former billionaire for the answer.
scenes.label: question

scenes.anchor: Ask my assistant. She remembers everything.
scenes.description: Young body tries to delegate a childhood memory to his assistant.
scenes.label: assistant

scenes.anchor: She wasn't there when you were six.
scenes.description: Viewer points out that she was not there when he was six.
scenes.label: six

scenes.description: Viewer makes one finite phone-tapping gesture while trying Titan.
scenes.label: titan-entry

scenes.description: The phone rejects the first answer on the spoken Wrong.
scenes.label: wrong

scenes.description: An uppercase retry changes the letters, then fails again.
scenes.label: caps

scenes.anchor: You named that tiny hamster Titan?
scenes.description: Viewer reacts to the huge name given to the tiny animal.
scenes.label: business

scenes.description: Young body proudly remembers his pet’s office.
scenes.label: office

scenes.description: The cardboard lid starts opening on the cage question.
scenes.label: cage

scenes.anchor: A shoebox. A wheel. More exercise than my board.
scenes.description: A close view reveals the shoebox, tiny hamster and wheel.
scenes.label: shoebox

scenes.anchor: A shoebox. A wheel. More exercise than my board.
scenes.description: The hamster runs briefly inside the physical wheel and settles.
scenes.label: wheel

scenes.anchor: My bank account is being held hostage by a dead hamster.
scenes.description: Viewer reacts to the small, personal memory blocking access.
scenes.label: hostage

scenes.description: The young body remembers Mister Nibbles; the answer stays hidden until it is spoken.
scenes.label: nibbles

scenes.description: The metaphor becomes a physical vault with a tiny hamster guard.
scenes.label: security

scenes.anchor: Eight billion pounds. Protected by Mister Nibbles.
scenes.description: The open vault reveals the account balance.
scenes.label: payoff

scenes.anchor: Eight billion pounds. Protected by Mister Nibbles.
scenes.description: Mister Nibbles gives one finite salute, recovers and holds through the ending.
scenes.label: guard
